'''Sellot Kell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kell became a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], she was among a group of Believers who served [[Garvin Delquist]] in the [[Almas Sith fortress]] and she became one of his bodyguards.
